summary: Allocate and initialize a resource buffer struct through an allocator object (this). Uses the allocation callback at this+0x20 with the allocator handle at this+0x28 to allocate a primary struct (size 64), a secondary fixed-size buffer (tag 8, size 1440) and a variable-size buffer (tag 1, size a3). On success stores the buffers at v3[9] and v3[10], initializes the struct (v3[0]=0, v3[11]=a3+size, v3[14]=a2) and calls sub_52765A to reset/initialize it, then returns the struct. On any allocation failure, frees previously allocated blocks via the release callback at this+0x24 and returns 0.

operations.description: Allocate the primary struct: call the allocation callback at this+0x20 with the allocator handle at this+0x28, tag 1 and size 64, storing the result in v3.
Primary allocation guard: when v3 is null, return 0 immediately (BLOCKED).
Allocate the secondary fixed-size buffer: call the allocation callback at this+0x20 with the handle at this+0x28, tag 8 and size 1440, storing the result in v4.
Store the secondary buffer pointer at v3[9] (dword index 9 of the primary struct).
Secondary allocation guard: when v4 is null, release v3 through the callback at this+0x24 with the handle at this+0x28, then return 0 (BLOCKED).
Allocate the variable-size buffer: call the allocation callback at this+0x20 with the handle at this+0x28, tag 1 and size a3, storing the result in v6.
Store the variable-size buffer pointer at v3[10] (dword index 10 of the primary struct).
Variable allocation guard: when v6 is non-null take the success path; otherwise release v3[9] and v3 through the callback at this+0x24 with the handle at this+0x28, then return 0 (BLOCKED).
Initialize the struct header fields: v3[0] = 0, v3[11] = a3 + v6 (end of the variable buffer), v3[14] = a2.
Call sub_52765A(v3, a1, 0) to reset/initialize the newly allocated struct with the allocator context.
Return the initialized primary struct pointer v3 on success, or 0 on any allocation failure path.
